unitPolicy.systemFont: Android system default; system-ui is the portable descriptor
unitPolicy.circle: CircleShape serialized as 50%; square bounds remain native dp

native.unlistedMaterialRoles: Continue to inherit the project's Material 3 library defaults; not fabricated here.
native.tonalRampAuthority: All 8-step OKLCH ramps are synthesized documentation previews from frontmatter colors; they are not app tokens or a proposal to change the palette.
native.elevationPolicy: No custom shadowElevation, tonalElevation, animation duration or easing is declared in the inspected app/UI source. Material 3 owns modal, ripple and focus behavior.

statePolicy.selection: Native selected semantics plus text/weight/check/underline; not color alone.
statePolicy.position: Only active position instantiates DigitGrid; changing it preserves all three sets.
statePolicy.input: Native OutlinedTextField; defaults own focus, cursor, error and IME behavior.
statePolicy.save: Disabled when invalid/not ready/saving; local progress while saving; feedback allows undo/continue/view.
statePolicy.failure: Preserve existing content and show local retry/status.
statePolicy.nativeAcceptance: Real historical data, full states, long content and both viewport/theme combinations.
statePolicy.sheet: ModalBottomSheet dragHandle=null; a static 32x4dp outline marker with 2dp corners is placed at the beginning of content (12dp above, 4dp below). The marker has no handle-slot click/tooltip semantics; close, system back and native sheet dragging remain.
statePolicy.report: When options is empty, request refresh/retry; only suggest another issue when options exist. Image decode/read failure has its own reload message.

previewPolicy.unitMapping: For preview illustration only, 1dp and 1sp map to 1 CSS px at font scale 1.
previewPolicy.interaction: CSS hover/focus/active treatment makes document controls inspectable; it does not prescribe Android behavior.
previewPolicy.assets: Inline SVG sketches indicate Material icon positions; actual Android icons remain Icons.Outlined.
previewPolicy.sampleData: 007 and position choices are format specimens, not draw facts.
previewPolicy.nativeEvidence: Use native screenshots, control bounds and functional tests; see docs/ui-research/native-regions.json.

userDecisions: Stronger color and smaller denser components

narrative.overview:
叁序是日常使用的原生 Android 数据工具。酒红身份区承担页面识别，石墨文字承担阅读，暖灰底与浅色内容面承托数字。视觉重心来自开奖号、正在编辑的位置和当前动作，减少大块留白，让用户在手机上完成一件清楚的事。

用户已经选择 B 纵向位选与开奖号优先的首页，随后明确要求颜色更有力度、组件更小、单屏信息更多。本文件提取修订后的 Compose 实现；这些选择不等于最终审美已获认可。记录时原生截图 QA 仍在进行，本文不宣布截图、业务流程或最终发布验收完成。
keyCharacteristics: 酒红身份区、暖灰背景、石墨正文；浅色与深色分别定义原生角色。
紧凑内容分组，操作至少 48dp；内容区与系统安全区分别计算。
号码使用系统等宽字体，数字、文字、勾选与线条共同表达状态。
平台组件承担输入、反馈和模态行为，普通内容面不添加自定义阴影。

rules.name: Native Role Pair
rules.body: 按同一主题成对使用 ColorScheme 容器与其 on 色；保留原生角色名称，不用单一酒红常量替换所有语义。

rules.name: Data Has Shape
rules.body: 号码保持三位与前导零；等宽数字、标签、勾选或线条提供可见状态，颜色不独自承担含义。

rules.name: Compact Content, Full Target
rules.body: 通过减少留白、合并表头和只展开当前输入来提高密度；可操作区域不得因此小于 48dp。

rules.name: Flat Content
rules.body: 普通内容面靠色面、间距和分隔形成层级；模态弹层、输入反馈和按压反馈遵从原生 Material 3 行为，不新增装饰性阴影。

dos: Do 使用当前主题的原生颜色角色及对应 on 色，新增页面沿用同一套字号、间距和圆角。
Do 保持至少 48dp 的操作范围；将说明和操作放在所属内容附近。
Do 让三个位置摘要持续可见，仅展开当前位的十键数字区。
Do 用真实历史数据检查密度、前导零、长文本和极端结果；完整号码进入明细。
Do 为加载、空、失败、无网、重试及保存反馈保留明确状态；失败时保留已有内容。
Do 在 360×800dp 与 393×851dp 的原生深浅色截图中检查核心任务可见性，并独立完成业务验证。
donts: Don't 恢复用户已否定的青蓝身份配色、苍白的整体效果、过大的留白或三套同时展开的数字键。
Don't 将首页的开奖号优先构图推广成所有页面的大数字布局；其他页面按自己的任务组织。
Don't 用装饰大卡片包裹每个短按钮，或通过缩小触控范围获得紧凑感。
Don't 把第三方彩报原图、生成效果图或其文字当作 APK 资产、正式开奖或验收数据。
Don't 把 HTML/CSS 检测、网页像素对比、构建通过或文档生成写成 Android 验收与用户审美认可。
